<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant peak at m/z 141 with a ~9 % M+1 peak and rapidly decreasing higher isotopologues spaced ~1 Da apart—the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution (≈1.1 % per carbon). No characteristic 2 Da halogen patterns (Cl, Br) or other distinctive isotopic signatures are present, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from this spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
